item.description:
# What's New in TablePro 0.87.0-beta.1
### Added
- PostgreSQL notices such as RAISE NOTICE show in the Output view, and a plan from EXPLAIN ANALYZE gains Output too. ([#4061](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4061)) - Export Results… has a keyboard shortcut, ⌥⇧⌘E, which you can change in Settings > Keyboard. ([#4066](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4066)) - tablepro completion prints a completion script for zsh, bash and fish. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - tablepro pair and tablepro unpair pair the command with TablePro or revoke its token. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - The tablepro command lists databases, schemas and tables, describes and exports tables, and reports its status. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - The get_table_health MCP tool returns Table Health findings to a connected client. ([#4167](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4167)) - Table Health checks redundant and invalid indexes, values near their limit, transaction ID age and stale statistics. ([#4167](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4167)) - Table Health finds reclaimable space on MySQL and MariaDB. ([#4167](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4167)) - Table Health marks new findings, keeps resolved ones and lets you ignore a finding, per database. ([#4167](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4167)) - Table Health exports findings to CSV, Excel, JSON and other formats, copies them, and saves every fix as one script. ([#4167](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4167))
### Changed
- On iOS, usage data goes to PostHog instead of TablePro's server, and only after you choose Share Usage Data. ([#4058](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4058)) - SQL passed to tablepro query that starts with a dash now goes after --. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - tablepro opens files and links in the TablePro it ships in, and a hidden connection exits 2 like an unknown one. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - tablepro exits 2 for a target that is neither a URL nor a file; open a file named like a command with tablepro open. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - With Reduce Transparency on, themes now color the sidebar and inspector on macOS 26 and later. ([#4153](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4153)) - Table Health opens one tab per database and stays on it when the sidebar switches database. ([#4167](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4167))
### Fixed
- Oracle output from a grid save, Commit or an AI statement showed under the next statement run from the editor. ([#4061](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4061)) - The Restore Previous Values toolbar button ignored a shortcut assigned to it in Settings > Keyboard. ([#4066](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4066)) - A database or schema's Export… in the sidebar showed ⇧⌘E, which exports the selected tables instead. ([#4066](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4066)) - tablepro query with TablePro closed could start another copy of TablePro, or the iPad app, and then time out. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - Settings offered a tablepro link line that broke once TablePro left its disk image. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - tablepro --help and tablepro --version opened TablePro instead of printing help or the version. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - Revoking an MCP token showed it as revoked even when TablePro could not save the change. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - Bars in the inspector lost their background under a theme on macOS 13 to 15. ([#4153](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4153)) - The license notice over Charts and Query Insights covered a themed window in system gray with Reduce Transparency on. ([#4153](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4153)) - Filter bar rows no longer center or drift out of line when a value is a pop-up, Between or Raw SQL. ([#4164](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4164)) - Table Health reported a PostgreSQL standby's activity counters and objects an extension owns. ([#4167](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4167)) - Saving a connection deleted its API token, TOTP secret or key passphrase when the Keychain could not be read. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Edits left on a background tab were reapplied to a different result that arrived while it was hidden. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A DuckDB query over a very large result held every row in memory twice before showing the first page. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Items deleted on another Mac while their sync category was off stayed here and could come back everywhere. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Exporting an empty PostgreSQL table to CSV with field names wrote no header line. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Format Query put spaces around the @ of a MySQL account name or quoted user variable. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Saving, switching tabs during the Safe Mode prompt, then approving wiped the other tab's edits. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Deleting a row with unsaved edits could delete a different row, or none. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Editing a field inside an Elasticsearch object left the old value in the document beside the new one. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Editing a Redis string value in the grid removed the key's TTL. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Editing a string in an untyped SurrealDB field to text that looks like a number changed its type. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Renaming an etcd key or adding one overwrote an existing key, and a rename took two separate steps. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Adding an Elasticsearch row with an _id that exists replaced the existing document. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A sidebar command on another database's table ran on the current database when the switch failed. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Redoing a cell edit on a row with another unsaved edit showed the value but never saved it. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Choosing Save on a second closing tab while the first was still saving left the first tab unclosable. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Copying a PostgreSQL text array into a JSON column wrote invalid JSON or turned strings into numbers. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - After a dropped connection reconnected, statements ran outside the transaction that was lost, with no error. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Rebuilding a SQLite table with a transaction open in the editor deleted its child rows. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Copy DDL and SQL export recreated a PostgreSQL partitioned or unlogged table as a plain table. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Renaming a Redis key or adding a string key overwrote an existing key of that name. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Editing a MySQL or MariaDB BIT cell saved the wrong value: 5 was stored as 53. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Cmd+Return right after typing in a very large script ran the text from before the last keystrokes. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A save could fail on a unique constraint because edits ran before earlier deletes. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Query parameters mistook Snowflake paths, array slices or ClickHouse typed slots for :name parameters. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A transaction opened in a tab on another PostgreSQL database was silently rolled back after a few minutes. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A query approved in Safe Mode after switching tabs ran in the newly selected tab's database. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Shortcuts Add Rows inserted empty CSV cells as empty strings instead of NULL or the column default. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - One unreadable saved MCP token, or a failed keychain read, removed every paired client's token. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Format Query split PostgreSQL operators such as pgvector's <#> or pg_trgm's <%. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - XLSX export turned text such as 1E5 or Infinity into numbers and lost digits of long ids. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Pasting spreadsheet rows whose first cell is empty shifted every value one column left. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - CSV import silently dropped extra fields. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A failed trigger edit could leave the trigger dropped with only a syntax error shown. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - An outside MCP server with long or dotted tool names made every chat request on its connections fail. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A DuckDB export or table copy of more than 5,000,000 rows stopped at 5,000,000 and reported success. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Pasting or bulk-editing tens of thousands of rows froze the window for many seconds. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Reopening a closed connection from a deeplink or history replaced its saved tabs with one tab. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Keyword casing rewrote words inside string literals and in non-SQL editors such as MongoDB. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Stopping the assistant during a tool call broke the conversation; every later message failed. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Parquet export wrote NULL for values that did not fit the column type, with no warning. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Editing a MySQL or MariaDB trigger dropped it and ran its body as a statement. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A long Snowflake statement was run a second time when the session expired while it ran. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Kafka topics and SurrealDB tables were browsed with a generic SQL SELECT instead of the driver's own query. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A SQL dump of a MySQL BIT column restored different values than the table held. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Saving a password failed silently when the Keychain held both a synced and a local copy for the connection. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Running a query over an edited result discarded the unsaved edits without asking. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A Snowflake statement still running after 45 minutes was reported as failed but kept running on the server. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A structure save that failed part way on MySQL left edits staged that could not be saved again. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Parquet export wrote wrong bytes for binary values and NULL for an empty one. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - An error sent mid-stream by an OpenAI-compatible or Gemini provider ended the reply silently. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Editing a MongoDB string field to text that looks like a number or boolean changed its type. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A write that outlasted the MCP or assistant timeout was reported as failed although it was applied. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Return and Delete on a selected row in the Welcome window, Favorites and the connections strip no longer do nothing. ([#4175](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4175)) - The host, attached database and extension lists in the connection form no longer hide the rows that do not fit. ([#4175](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4175)) - On macOS 27, clicking a row in a list or table no longer leaves its selection grey and the arrow keys going elsewhere. ([#4175](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4175)) - MySQL statements on iOS that ran past 30 seconds failed while the server kept running and committed them. ([#4177](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4177)) - Saving a password on iOS with Sync Passwords off deleted the iCloud Keychain copy your other devices use. ([#4177](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4177)) - Stop on iOS left a MySQL statement running on the server, which then committed it. ([#4177](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4177)) - Switching apps on iOS with a DuckDB transaction open rolled it back without any message. ([#4177](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4177)) - A password saved on iOS while Sync Passwords was off went unused once Sync Passwords was turned back on. ([#4177](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4177)) - A PostgreSQL query on iOS hung for about two hours when the network dropped its reply. ([#4177](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4177)) - A password saved while Sync Passwords was off went unused once Sync Passwords was turned back on. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Items deleted on another Mac came back after iCloud sync had to download everything again. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Saving a connection rewrote passwords you did not change, overwriting a newer one saved on another device. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Editing a SurrealDB field that held both strings and numbers changed the edited value's type. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Claude Agent asked for MCP access to the chat's connection on every message at Ask Once. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Pasting spreadsheet rows with empty cells wrote NULL instead of the column's default value. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Switching databases on a connection that reconnects to switch rolled back an open transaction without asking. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Saving, closing or switching tabs right after typing in a very large script lost the last keystrokes. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - A structure save or column reorder that failed part way did not say which changes were already applied. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Importing, copying or syncing rows into a MySQL or MariaDB BIT column stored the wrong value: 5 became 53. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Adding a Redis hash, list, set or sorted set key in the grid wrote into an existing key of that name. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Reading a SQLite full-text search table over MCP or from the assistant failed with authorization denied. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - A MySQL or MariaDB query with no query timeout hung for about two hours when the network dropped its reply. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - Text over 4 KB in a SQL Server, Oracle or DuckDB table on iOS could not be loaded in full, edited or copied. ([#4179](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4179)) - A large MySQL or SQL Server query on iOS kept downloading every remaining row after the row cap was reached. ([#4179](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4179)) - The query timeout on iOS was ignored on PostgreSQL, Redshift and Oracle, and as a lock timeout on SQL Server. ([#4179](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4179)) - A MySQL result on iOS that exactly filled the row cap said more rows were left out. ([#4179](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4179)) - After a low-memory trim on iOS, the data browser's page range named rows it no longer showed. ([#4179](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4179))
### Security
- tablepro export printed control codes stored in the database to the terminal, where they could run. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - The tablepro command and the MCP bridge could send their token to a program that replaced TablePro's socket. ([#4145](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4145)) - MCP argument completion listed a connection's databases and tables to a client that was not approved for it. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Deleting the connections.json tag file let an edited connection list run its password and tunnel commands. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - A Local only connection's newly saved passwords and keys still synced through iCloud Keychain. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - Claude Agent could reach every saved connection through MCP instead of only the one the chat is on. ([#4174](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4174)) - MCP clients and the AI assistant could read masked values through a renamed column, a query plan or an error message. ([#4178](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4178)) - When the saved SSH host keys could not be read, a server whose key had changed was offered as a new server to trust. ([#4179](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4179))
[View release notes](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/releases/tag/v0.87.0-beta.1)

# What's New in TablePro 0.86.0
Sign in with a TablePro account to use your plan, see your devices and sync a team library. A license key from an earlier version moves into your account the first time the app opens.
A dropped connection keeps its rows while it reconnects, with Cancel, and every surface shows the same connection state.
Imports, exports, backups, restores and transfers share one progress sheet, and Quit, Close and Disconnect ask once about work still running.
Remote DuckDB connections can go through an SSH tunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel, SOCKS proxy or tunnel command, and now require the Token instead of secrets in ~/.duckdb.
A raw SQL filter can no longer run a second statement, and a DuckDB token no longer reaches another server that a later ATTACH names.
Sending feedback from inside the app is no longer available.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

item.description:
# What's New in TablePro 0.86.0-beta.1
### Added
- A dropped connection keeps its rows and shows a reconnecting bar with Cancel, then Reconnect after 10 tries. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - Settings > MCP offers Try Again when the server fails to start, and says when the port you set was in use. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Linked folders show what each scan found, and Settings > License > Team shows the team library's last refresh. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Downloading cloud-sql-proxy shows its progress with Cancel, and connecting says when it downloads. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Quit, Close and Disconnect ask once, in one alert listing the restores, imports, exports and queries still running. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - A notification when an agent session waits for your answer or its reply fails while you are elsewhere. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Plugin installs and updates show their progress with Cancel, and a failed update stays in Settings with Try Again. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Remote DuckDB connections can go through an SSH tunnel, Cloudflare Tunnel, SOCKS proxy or tunnel command. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - Sign in with a TablePro account to unlock paid features, see your devices and sync a team library. ([#4045](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4045))
### Changed
- The connections strip, Welcome, the switcher, menus and the iOS app show one connection state, only when it needs you. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - The welcome window shows a license that needs attention and iCloud sync problems, each linking to the fix. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - Notices, warnings and errors use the standard macOS look: color only on the symbol, with no tinted boxes, dots or chips. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Connection tags are edited in a token field: type a name to add or create a tag, and press Delete to remove one. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Plugins that could not load are listed in Settings > Extensions with the reason, Update, Try Again and Remove. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - On iOS, a saved row no longer shows a toast, and NULL, Default and column types use standard buttons and text. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - A finished tab shows a checkmark and a failed one a red triangle, where both showed the same dot. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Imports, exports, backups, restores, transfers and copies share one progress sheet, and Escape asks before stopping. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - The MCP disconnect tool refuses while the connection has running work, unsaved changes or an open transaction. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - Remote DuckDB connections now require the Token and no longer read secrets saved in ~/.duckdb. ([#4021](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4021)) - etcd keys and values that are not UTF-8 show as hex, and a quoted `\xHH` in an etcd command writes that byte. ([#4023](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4023)) - A license key from an earlier version moves into your TablePro account the first time the app opens. ([#4045](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4045))
### Removed
- Sending feedback from inside the app is no longer available. ([#4045](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4045))
### Fixed
- A failed connect showed as disconnected on the connections strip, and a lost connection as failed. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - On iOS, a lost connection stopped reconnecting after one failed try. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - The toolbar lost the connection's name after a disconnect. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - Cancelling a reconnect after an SSH tunnel dropped did not stop it, and the connection could come back on its own. ([#4001](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4001)) - Try Again on a license check showed nothing when the check failed. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - Pro features asked a license that could not be checked for 30 days, or was suspended, to buy a license. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - Sync Now showed for iCloud problems that trying again cannot clear, such as a restricted account. ([#4005](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4005)) - The MCP status said the port was in use whenever the failure text happened to contain 48. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Notes from MySQL and SQLite maintenance, such as an OPTIMIZE note or an integrity check problem, were never shown. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - Settings > Notifications kept showing an old permission after it was changed in System Settings. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - A GitHub Copilot error showed only inside its provider sheet while the provider row said Not signed in. ([#4007](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4007)) - A restore's progress bar never moved. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - A team library pull kept connection settings it should have removed until TablePro restarted. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Restores, comparisons and sync scripts never notified when they finished out of sight. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Quitting left a restore or backup tool running in the background. ([#4009](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4009)) - Importing from another app now keeps the TLS, key passphrases and extra connection files that app saved. ([#4015](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4015)) - Restore Previous Values stayed enabled with nothing to restore, then only showed an alert. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - The selected connection in the sidebar showed a blank white badge when it was lost or failed. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - An export or table transfer kept running with no window after a disconnect that did not ask first. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - On iOS, the NULL button moved across the field when turned on while editing a row. ([#4018](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4018)) - Raw filter rows were offered on etcd, DynamoDB, Memcached, Weaviate, InfluxDB and Kafka, which cannot run them. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Loading a filter preset turned its same element rows into any element rows. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Raw SQL filters on SQL Server and Oracle failed with an invalid column error. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Changing a filter's operator kept the old Match Case setting, and Search All Rows matched case. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Duplicate Filter dropped Match Case and the element scope, and put the cursor in the wrong row. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - The cell Filter menu added a second copy of a filter that was already running. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - Switching a filter row between Raw SQL and a column hid the text you had typed. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - A page turn, sort or refresh ran filter edits that had not been applied. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - A filter that could not run, such as raw SQL with a comment, loaded every row while showing as applied. ([#4019](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4019)) - MongoDB exports cut nested values at 10,000 characters. ([#4020](https://github.com/TableProApp/TablePro/pull/4020)) - MQL exports lost special field names and changed numeric field order. # What's New in TablePro 0.85.0
Neo4j, InfluxDB 2 and 3, Qdrant, Memcached and StarRocks connections, and KingbaseES with a downloadable driver.
Two to six query results show as tabs, and the Structure tab shows columns, indexes, foreign keys and checks on one page.
Masking rules hide column values in the grid, copies, exports, the AI assistant and MCP. Table Health finds bloat and unused indexes.
Routine Debugger steps through PL/pgSQL and PL/SQL, and Live Messages watches PostgreSQL notifications, Redis channels and Kafka topics.
Imported and synced connections ask before using cloud or Kerberos sign-ins, and PostgreSQL reads ~/.pgpass only when you turn it on.
Settings > Plugins is now Settings > Extensions. A .sql-formatter.json saved by 0.83 needs exporting again with sql-formatter's key names.
[View full changelog](https://docs.tablepro.app/changelog)

# What's New in TablePro 0.84.0
Find and Replace work in every data grid, with Match Case, Whole Words, regular expressions and a column scope.
Click a sorted header to reverse it or Option-click to add a sort key. Frozen columns sort, resize and reorder from their own headers.
A cell value with a line break or over 256 characters opens in an editor anchored to the cell.
The sidebar, Open Quickly, autocomplete and AI chat no longer stall on databases with tens of thousands of tables.
Procedures and Functions load on MySQL 5.x and MariaDB servers with many routines, and MariaDB packages open.
Save Changes has its own toolbar section, and panes switch views with native tabs.
